name: dotclaude
description: Adds guards against destructive commands and weakened tests, a check gate before Claude stops, carry-over of the user's messages across compaction, a model and effort lock that follows the Claude plan, working rules for each session, four output styles, and task agents on tiered models.

guard_bash.title: Bash guard
guard_bash.description: Ask before destructive git/filesystem/database commands, hook bypasses, and public side effects (publish, gh writes, Claude Design writes outside /design-sync); deny recursive searches that walk gitignored build output.

guard_ask_in_auto.title: Ask about recoverable actions in auto mode
guard_ask_in_auto.description: In auto mode, the guards stay quiet about recoverable actions (deleting git-tracked files, find/fd deletes, generated-file edits) and let the auto mode classifier decide. Turn on to be asked anyway.

guard_edit.title: Edit guard
guard_edit.description: Ask before edits that delete test assertions, add skip markers, touch generated files, or edit Claude settings files.

guard_secrets.title: Secret redaction
guard_secrets.description: Scan every tool output with Betterleaks and replace each secret it finds with [REDACTED:<rule>] before the model sees it. Needs betterleaks on PATH. Without it, output passes through and session start says so.

context_session_files.title: Exclude session files
context_session_files.description: When an agent creates a handoff note in `.claude/handoffs/`, `.dotclaude/` loop state, `CLAUDE.local.md`, `.claude/settings.local.json`, or `.claude/worktrees/`, add the path to `.git/info/exclude`, so it stays out of commits.

context_line_breaks.title: Line-break check
context_line_breaks.description: After an edit, tell Claude when the text that it wrote breaks lines at a column, not between sentences or clauses. Uses `semlf` when it is on PATH, and a built-in check otherwise. Off by default, because the line-break style is a project convention.

context_nested_instructions.title: Nested instructions
context_nested_instructions.description: When a Bash command reads files in a subdirectory with its own CLAUDE.md, add that file to the context once, as the Read tool does. Claude Code loads these files only for the Read tool.

gate_verify.title: Verify-before-stop gate
gate_verify.description: Send Claude back once when it stops after editing code without a later passing test/build/lint run.

gate_tasks.title: Open-task check
gate_tasks.description: Send Claude back once when it ends a turn with tasks still pending or in progress, so it updates the task list.

gate_goal_stall.title: End stalled /goal loops
gate_goal_stall.description: When Claude Code's /goal check blocks a stop twice in a row and Claude did no work in between, end the turn. Say only you can end the goal early, with /goal clear. Otherwise each round re-reads the whole context, up to Claude Code's cap of 9.

context_auto_clear.title: Automatic handoff and clear
context_auto_clear.description: When the main context reaches 100k tokens, the next typed prompt saves a handoff note under `.claude/handoffs/`, runs `/clear`, and sends the prompt again in the cleared session, so the next part starts from the note and not from a compaction summary. Costs one extra model call on the full context.

context_compact_carryover.title: Compaction carry-over
context_compact_carryover.description: After compaction, restore your last few prompts verbatim plus git diff stat and the last check result.

context_compaction_handoff.title: Compaction handoff note
context_compaction_handoff.description: Before a compaction of the main conversation, ask the main model for a handoff note, save it under `.claude/handoffs/`, and add it to the compacted conversation. Costs one extra model call on the full context.

notify_desktop.title: Desktop notifications
notify_desktop.description: Show a desktop notification when the main agent ends a turn, asks a question, or needs a permission, with the task, the short session ID, and the repository. Sends one reminder after 5 minutes with no answer. Uses terminal-notifier, or osascript on macOS. Shows nothing when neither exists.

context_handoff_pointer.title: Point new sessions at the handoff note
context_handoff_pointer.description: At startup and after `/clear`, when `.claude/handoffs/` holds a handoff note whose status is `in-progress` or `blocked`, tell Claude where the newest one is and to check it against the repository before it continues.

usage_scratchpad_prune_days.title: Prune idle scratchpads after (days)
usage_scratchpad_prune_days.description: At session start, delete Claude Code session scratchpads and loose temp entries under /tmp/claude-<uid> (or $CLAUDE_CODE_TMPDIR) that nobody has touched for this many days. Builds left there can take gigabytes. The current session is never pruned. 0 turns it off.

agent_guidance.title: Subagent guidance
agent_guidance.description: Give subagents a short version of the dotclaude working conventions when they start (the main conversation gets them through the dotclaude output style). dotclaude's own agents rely on it for the shared working-tree rules, the progress log, and the report format.

usage_agent_bounds.title: Hand off agents at their turn or context limit
usage_agent_bounds.description: Once any subagent's context passes about 100k tokens (150k for the dotclaude `reviewer`), or a dotclaude agent nears its turn limit, refuse its tool calls. Its next action is then a report. When a subagent stops at its turn limit anyway, rewrite the first message to it into a request for a handoff report. Block any later messages to it. The work then continues in a fresh agent with a small context, instead of a resumed one that re-reads its whole history on every turn.

model_lock.title: Fast-mode and model lock
model_lock.description: Block fast mode and block switches or subagent calls to models outside the allowed list.

model_plan.title: Claude plan
model_plan.description: auto (default) reads the plan from Claude Code's cached account. Pick a plan when detection is wrong. On Pro and standard Team seats without extra usage, the model lock leaves Fable out. Session start notes what the plan means for model choice.

usage_notes.title: Usage notes
usage_notes.description: When Claude Code's cached usage shows the session or weekly limit past 75% or 90%, tell Claude once per level. Claude then routes the remaining work to stretch what is left. Past 100k tokens of main context, tell Claude the context size on each prompt, and once in a long run of tool calls. When a turn stops on a usage limit, show a terminal notification with the reset time and the resume command.

model_allowed.title: Allowed models
model_allowed.description: Comma-separated model IDs or version prefixes the model lock permits.

git_commit_hygiene.title: Commit hygiene
git_commit_hygiene.description: On git commit, ask when the staged set contains .DS_Store, .env files, keys, build output, or a lockfile without its manifest.

git_attribution.title: Git attribution
git_attribution.description: Add Claude Code's Co-Authored-By commit trailer and pull request footer, which the settings profile's includeGitInstructions: false removes. The attribution setting still changes or removes them. Turn off for no attribution.
